versions.changelog:
- Connects Codex to GetYouTubeTranscript through the OOMOL `oo` CLI using server-side credentials.
- Retrieves YouTube video transcripts by URL or ID, including title and channel metadata.
- Supports optional per-line timestamps for transcript output.
- Searches YouTube for videos or channels with paginated results.
- Lists playlist videos and channel videos one page at a time.
- Checks remaining credits, plan details, and rate-limit status.
